section.title: Cloud-native &sap; workloads
section.para: With the current trend toward cloud-based services, the need arises to connect on-premises systems to these cloud-based services. To support these scenarios, &rancherforsap; provides a complete software stack tailored for hosting your containerized &sap; edge workloads, complementing the corresponding &sap; cloud counterparts, specifically &sap; &sapeic; (&sapeica;) and &sap; &sapdme;. You deploy these solutions on lightweight &k8s; clusters virtualized within hyperconverged infrastructure. &rancherforsap; provides this infrastructure.

section.title: &sap; &sapeic;
section.para: &sap; &sapeic; (&sapeica;) acts as an on-premises integration runtime, complementing the cloud-based &sap; Integration Suite by bringing integration flows close to your on-premises systems. To run &sapeica; in a supported, production-ready and resilient configuration, you must deploy the workload on &ranchera; &k8s; Engine 2 (&rke2a;) clusters managed by &rancherprime;. You run these clusters inside virtual machines hosted on &svirtualization;.
&sap; validates &sapeic; on certain &k8s; platforms. You can find the support matrix in &sapnote; 3247839.
You can access &suse; Best Practices Guides for &sap; Edge Integration Cell at .

section.title: &sap; &sapdme;
section.para: &sap; &sapdme; extends your cloud-based &sap; Digital Manufacturing to the shop floor, ensuring continuous manufacturing operations even during cloud disconnections. You can deploy &sapdme; on the same virtualized &rancherprime; and &svirtualization; (Harvester) infrastructure by using virtualized &rke2a; clusters running on &slm; 6.0.
You can access &suse; Best Practices Guides for &sapdme; at .
